definitions.gloss: mountain trail; hiking trail; climbing path
definitions.explanation: A path or trail used for climbing a mountain. A designated route for hikers and climbers.

examples.japanese: {登山道|とざんどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mountain trail is well maintained.

examples.japanese: {登山道|とざんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A map was installed at the trailhead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{登山道|とざんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦{崩|くず}れて→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になっている。
examples.english: Part of the mountain trail collapsed due to the typhoon and is closed to traffic.

notes:
A designated path for climbing a mountain. Unlike general hiking paths (⟦{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}→遊歩道：23484_yuuhodou⟧), a {登山道|とざんどう} specifically leads to a summit or through mountain terrain.

FORMS:
⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧ (mountain climbing) + {道|どう} (path/road).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登山道|とざんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧: trailhead
- {登山道|とざんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk the mountain trail
- {登山道|とざんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: trail is closed
- {登山道|とざんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: to maintain the trail

CULTURAL NOTE:
Major mountains in Japan like ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧ have multiple numbered {登山道|とざんどう}. Trails may be closed seasonally due to weather or snow.
